_meta.purpose: Golden regression scenarios for the AdProof forecast engine.
_meta.honest_framing: These test STABILITY + SANITY of the deterministic core (seeded Monte Carlo) plus the copy_critique + linguistics layers. They do NOT measure real-world ACCURACY — that needs real campaign outcomes to score against (the backtest, unlockable once real data flows). See run_eval.py header.
_meta.mode: LLM-free + deterministic: critics disabled via env flags, heuristic profile/audience parse, fixed seed.
